job_description: TradeCo is hiring a Software Developer to join our core platform team. Responsibilities include building backend services and APIs, collaborating with product teams, and improving system reliability. Mandatory requirements: (M1) 3+ years of commercial software development experience using Python or Java; (M2) Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs; (M3) Demonstrable knowledge of SQL and relational databases; (M4) Familiarity with unit and integration testing practices; (M5) Right to work in New Zealand (or specify eligibility). Preferred: (P1) Experience with Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions or AKS); (P2) Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. The job also asks for strong communication and ability to reason about trade-offs when designing systems.
candidate_profile: Candidate has 4 years experience at a small SaaS firm building Python-based backend services. Implemented REST APIs for subscription billing, wrote SQL queries and schema migrations for PostgreSQL, and introduced unit tests using pytest. Familiar with Docker; contributed to a team evaluation of Kubernetes but has no production AKS deployments. Holds permanent residency enabling right to work. Has strong written communication, documented API design decisions.
